title: The Great Blanket Fort Kingdom
subtitle: Build it big enough for everyone — or it falls apart

pages.text: Thunder grumbled outside. "FORT DAY!" shouted Bluey, dragging every blanket in the house. Muffin arrived with Socks on her hip. Lia unzipped her backpack and pulled out a rainbow blanket. "I brought reinforcements," she said proudly.

Bandit held chairs steady while Bingo clipped sheets with pegs. "The Kingdom of Cozy needs a throne room!" Muffin announced, stacking cushions taller than Socks. Socks toppled them immediately. Everyone laughed.
The first fort was magnificent — for about eleven seconds. CRASH! It collapsed on Bandit's head. "I'm okay," came a muffled voice. "The kingdom has fallen!" Bluey wailed dramatically.
Chilli appeared with hot chocolate and a calm smile. "One door. One rule. One job each." She drew a tiny plan on a napkin. Lia nodded. "At my school we call that a team plan."

Bluey became Chief Architect. Bingo was Peg Patrol. Muffin guarded the Throne Room — but only after promising not to rename it Muffin Land. Bandit became Royal Guard, wedged between couch cushions. "Best job ever," he whispered.
Lia taped a paper sign: EVERYONE WELCOME. Socks crawled through the tunnel clapping. The fort grew long and low — room for all paws, all knees, all elbows.

Inside, they told stories by torchlight. Bingo's was about a gentle dragon. Bluey's involved seventeen helicopters. Muffin's was mostly about crackers. Lia told a story about a bridge built from kindness.

When the storm passed, sunlight striped the blanket roof. Chilli peeked in. "Your Majesty," she bowed, "dinner is served in the Kingdom of Cozy." They ate sandwiches on the floor and agreed: this was the best fort in the whole wide world.
